title: Paleobiology Database collections, all records, with present-day and PALEOMAP palaeocoordinates
citation: Paleobiology Database (https://paleobiodb.org), data service v1.2. Collections downloaded through colls/list with all_records. Original references are listed per collection in the database.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.statement: The Paleobiology Database releases its data under CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons announcement, 2013-12-19). Attribution asks for acknowledgement of the PBDB and citation of the original references.

query.note: A live database: the same query returns more records later. The file is pinned by size and SHA-256 once downloaded, and records carry their own created timestamps, which is what allows out-of-sample tests against datasets built from older downloads.

status: Collected to test land masks against marine and terrestrial fossil localities; not served.
